title: Meetings & Events Deposit Schedule by Package
content:
Meetings & Events deposits are scheduled as percentages of the contract's estimated revenue at up to three milestones: at signing, 90 calendar days before the event, and a final prepayment a set number of calendar days before the event. A percentage of 0 means the package has no deposit at that milestone.

| Package | Deposit at signing | Deposit 90 calendar days before the event | Final prepayment | Final prepayment due (calendar days before the event) | Deposits refunded on cancellation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Executive Boardroom Package | 0 percent | 0 percent | 0 percent | 0 (none) | No |
| Half-Day Meeting Package | 25 percent | 0 percent | 0 percent | 0 (none) | No |
| Full-Day Meeting Package | 25 percent | 25 percent | 0 percent | 0 (none) | No |
| Social Reception Package | 30 percent | 25 percent | 45 percent | 10 | No |
| Wedding Celebration Package | 25 percent | 25 percent | 50 percent | 10 | No |
| Conference Plenary Package | 25 percent | 25 percent | 0 percent | 0 (none) | No |

## What the schedule shows

- The Executive Boardroom Package takes no deposits at all.
- The Half-Day Meeting Package takes a single deposit, at signing.
- The Full-Day Meeting and Conference Plenary packages take deposits at signing and at 90 calendar days, with no final prepayment.
- The Social Reception and Wedding Celebration packages schedule all three: 30, 25 and 45 percent, and 25, 25 and 50 percent respectively, in each case totalling 100 percent of estimated revenue, with the final prepayment falling due 10 calendar days before the event.
- The deposits-refunded-on-cancellation setting reads No for every Meetings & Events package.

## Hypothetical illustration

A Wedding Celebration Package contract with an estimated revenue of 20,000.00 is scheduled for 5,000.00 at signing, 5,000.00 at 90 calendar days before the event and 10,000.00 at 10 calendar days before the event.
